question: Using data from both the regular season and the post-season, identify the pitcher who achieved the highest non-zero pitch speed for each team by confirming whether the pitcher’s ID appears in the relevant home or away player lists for that game, then retrieve that pitcher’s full name along with the maximum valid pitch speed they achieved while playing for that specific team.
sql:
WITH all_games AS (
  SELECT 
    pitcherId,
    pitcherFirstName,
    pitcherLastName,
    pitchSpeed,
    homeTeamId,
    homeTeamName,
    awayTeamId,
    awayTeamName,
    homeFielder1,
    awayFielder1
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_wide`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    pitcherId,
    pitcherFirstName,
    pitcherLastName,
    pitchSpeed,
    homeTeamId,
    homeTeamName,
    awayTeamId,
    awayTeamName,
    homeFielder1,
    awayFielder1
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_post_wide`
),
pitcher_games AS (
  SELECT 
    pitcherId,
    pitcherFirstName,
    pitcherLastName,
    pitchSpeed,
    CASE 
      WHEN pitcherId = homeFielder1 THEN homeTeamId
      ELSE awayTeamId
    END as pitcherTeamId,
    CASE 
      WHEN pitcherId = homeFielder1 THEN homeTeamName
      ELSE awayTeamName
    END as pitcherTeamName
  FROM all_games
  WHERE pitchSpeed > 0 AND pitcherId != ''
),
team_pitcher_max AS (
  SELECT 
    pitcherTeamId,
    pitcherTeamName,
    pitcherId,
    pitcherFirstName,
    pitcherLastName,
    MAX(pitchSpeed) as max_speed
  FROM pitcher_games
  GROUP BY pitcherTeamId, pitcherTeamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    pitcherTeamName,
    pitcherId,
    pitcherFirstName,
    pitcherLastName,
    max_speed,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pitcherTeamId ORDER BY max_speed DESC) as rn
  FROM team_pitcher_max
)
SELECT pitcherTeamName, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, max_speed
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY pitcherTeamName
